items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: That’s Howard Alden and myself, a Benny Carter tune called “The Courtship.”

ctx.x: Well you should they’re pretty good actually. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
Why thank you. But if I hear them like this back I’d say hey that’s not so bad. That’s Howard Alden and myself, a Benny Carter tune called “The Courtship.” It’s a beautiful song.
